items.exampleEn: The tennis court is next to the pool.
India has a very large population.
This agency helps people find jobs.
items.exampleZh: 這家仲介公司幫人找工作。
items.glossZh: 代辦機構；（旅行社等）公司

items.exampleEn: The cat attacked the toy mouse.
Lawyers often work very long hours.
items.exampleZh: 律師常常工作很長的時間。

items.exampleEn: This book is about a crime in a small town.
items.exampleZh: 這本書在講小鎮上的一件罪案。

items.exampleEn: My son wants a toy gun for his birthday.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子生日想要一把玩具槍。

items.exampleEn: My brother has a box of toy soldiers.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟有一盒玩具士兵。

items.sentenceEn: The population of this city is getting bigger.
items.sentenceZh: 這座城市的人口越來越多。

items.audioEn: We bought our tickets to Japan at a travel agency.
items.audioZh: 我們在旅行社買了去日本的機票。
items.questionZh: 他們在哪裡買去日本的機票？

items.sentenceEn: There is very little crime in this village.
Our school has two basketball courts.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校有兩座籃球場。

items.stemEn: If you have a problem with the law, talk to a ____.
items.stemZh: 如果你遇到法律問題，就去找律師談。

items.stemEn: The kids had fun with their water ____ on the hot day.
items.stemZh: 大熱天裡，孩子們玩水槍玩得很開心。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Mia's family visited London. They planned the trip with a travel agency. London has a big population, but it felt safe, and there was not much crime near their hotel. At an old castle, a soldier stood at the gate. "He doesn't move at all!" said Mia's little brother. Mia's mother is a lawyer, so she wanted to see a famous court. In the evening, they watched a football game, and the home team attacked again and again.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Mia 一家人去了倫敦。他們請旅行社安排這趟旅行。倫敦人口很多，但感覺很安全，飯店附近也很少有犯罪。在一座古堡前，有一位士兵站在大門口。Mia 的弟弟說：「他完全不動耶！」Mia 的媽媽是律師，所以她想去參觀一座有名的法院。晚上他們去看足球賽，主隊一次又一次地進攻。

questions.questionZh: 他們請誰安排這趟旅行？
Mia 的媽媽為什麼想去參觀一座有名的法院？

referenceEn: My aunt works as a lawyer.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 is a lawyer、works as a lawyer

items.instructionZh: 用 population 造一個句子，說說你住的城市或鄉鎮的人口。
referenceEn: The population of my city is about two million.
My town's population is getting smaller.
rubricZh: population 指「人口」（例如 the population of my city、a small population）
數字可寫例如 about two million
